top_signals.title: US Retail Diesel Hits Record as Hormuz, Russia Crises Stretch On
top_signals.summary: US retail diesel rose to a record, threatening to further spike energy-driven inflation as wars in Iran and Russia roil the market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Stocks and Treasuries Steady Before Jobs Data: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stocks and Treasuries held steady as traders waited to see whether Friday’s payrolls report will offer the Federal Reserve enough justification to hold off on an interest-rate hike in September.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The donor sting threatening Nigel Farage
top_signals.summary: A sting operation has abruptly overturned the Reform UK leader’s attempt to put financing scandals behind him
